selection_method: Interleaved seeded ordering within both taxa from the previously retrieved Flowers-annotated public pool. All historical-pilot and already-new-field-labeled observations excluded. Current public details and photos refreshed before review. Convenience/annotation-selected sample, not population frequency or independent validation. Continue candidates until 100 new observations are verified.

skipped_or_blocked.reason: Cultivated plant with marked clover-like leaves and cupped violet flower raises target-taxon identification doubt; leave fields untouched pending identification review.
